Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.transaction

Interface AIiTransactionCommitFailureContext<CO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput>

Type Parameters:
CO - typed commit output when present
All Superinterfaces:
eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionContext, AIiTransactionFinalizationContext
public interface AIiTransactionCommitFailureContext<CO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput> extends AIiTransactionFinalizationContext
Structured snapshot for a failure thrown by the commit action. The commit action must not attempt ad-hoc repair within its own commit method. It may still have yielded a partial or uncertain output and effect.
